snippet.title: Drill Core - Anniversary Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Drill Core's free Anniversary Update is OUT NOW on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox, with Nintendo Switch coming soon. 

Command your team, expand your platform, mine alien worlds to their core, and defend your operations in this explosive roguelike builder strategy game. Choose from three unique platforms—Humans, Dwarves, or Swarnids—and adapt your strategy to ever-changing, procedurally generated levels.

Join Drill Core Inc. today and build tomorrow's galaxy, one core at a time!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821800/Drill_Core/ 
X: https://twitter.com/drillcoregame
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@drillcoregame
